scope: Gemini-visible stop and post-stop status evidence; no control or motor behavior changed.
motivation: Zero walking speed is a request, not measured physical standstill. Selected mass/inertia simulation cases show persistent default-policy motion after eight seconds at zero command.
Controller-manager deactivation confirms software state, not physical torque, posture or a lying position.
changes: Stop replies describe command cancellation and zero-speed requests or confirmed controller deactivation. They explicitly retain unmeasured physical stopping/posture.
Removed the false provided-code premise that locomotion only moves while speed is commanded.
Corrected no-controller and locked-trick status strings and Gemini stop/status descriptions and prompt.

The existing course assertion required the word relaxed despite observing only controller state. It now retains the deactivation behavior check and requires truthful deactivation/unmeasured-outcome wording.

findings_closed: Post-stop robot_status incorrectly implied lying down.
Locked-trick status incorrectly said stop halts movement.

validation.initial_course_assertion_failure: Before updating the obsolete text assertion:165passed,1failed requiring relaxed; existing237behavioraltests passed. No physical result was fabricated to satisfy that assertion.

limitations: No new physical-stop sensing or policy correction is introduced.
Existing command cancellation, queue management, controller ownership and error quarantine are unchanged.
